package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestDirectives(t *testing.T) {
	//cleanuplint:allow // want:allow-directive
	_ = os.RemoveAll(os.Getenv("A")) // want:env-path-delete
	//cleanuplint:allow too short // want:allow-directive
	_ = os.RemoveAll(os.Getenv("B")) // want:env-path-delete

	//cleanuplint:allow nothing below this line needs a directive // want:allow-directive

	_ = os.Remove("x")
}
